source.author: ov
source.text: Utque Iovis praepes, vacuo cum vidit in arvo praebentem Phoebo liventia terga draconem, occupat aversum, neu saeva retorqueat ora, squamigeris avidos figit cervicibus ungues, sic celeri missus praeceps per inane volatu terga ferae pressit dextroque frementis in armo Inachides ferrum curvo tenus abdidit hamo.
source.text_original: Utque Iovis praepes, vacuo cum vidit in arvo / praebentem Phoebo liventia terga draconem, / occupat aversum, neu saeva retorqueat ora, / squamigeris avidos figit cervicibus ungues, / sic celeri missus praeceps per inane volatu / terga ferae pressit dextroque frementis in armo / Inachides ferrum curvo tenus abdidit hamo.
source.text_english: And as Jupiter’s bird, when it saw in the empty field the serpent offering its dark back to Phoebus, seizes it from behind, and, lest it turn its savage jaws back, fixes its greedy claws in its scaly neck, so, hurled headlong through the void at swift flight, the Inachian pressed the beast’s back and drove his iron into the right shoulder of the roaring creature, up to the bent hook.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_original: ' / dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco / direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua / in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit / Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit / protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit / purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_english: He spoke, and with a mighty furrow he sent through the void a blazing torch that, as it drew near the ship, parted into a twofold course and sought the sons of Tyndareus; peaceful, it at once clung to the middle of both their brows and pours forth a harmless purple light, once a thing to be implored by wretched sailors.
